description.en: Cleans AI traces from Russian text: finds chatbot copy-paste artefacts (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek) and rewrites the text into natural prose on request; 39 regex markers with an evidence registry, offline, text-only bundle.
description.zh: 清理俄语文本中的 AI 痕迹：识别聊天机器人复制粘贴的痕迹（ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok、Perplexity、DeepSeek），按需改写为自然文风；39 条正则标记与证据登记，离线纯文本 bundle。
